Jade_Ahri.name: Ahri
Jade_Ahri.title: The Nine-Tailed Fox

skins.name: After Hours Spirit Blossom Springs Ahri

Jade_Ahri.lore:
- Essence Theft (P) is stacked on damaging enemies
- Spirit Rush (R) doesn't reset
- Charm (E) increases Ahri's damage to her target
Jade_Ahri.blurb:
- Essence Theft (P) is stacked on damaging enemies
- Spirit Rush (R) doesn't reset
- Charm (E) increases Ahri's damage to her target

spells.name: Orb of Deception
spells.description: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.
spells.tooltip: Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> on the way out and <trueDamage>{{ totaldamage }} true damage</trueDamage> on the way back.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Fox-Fire
spells.description: Ahri releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip: Ahri releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, reduced to <magicDamage>{{ halfdamage }} damage</magicDamage> beyond the first.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Charm
spells.description: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and Charms the first enemy hit. They also take more damage from her for several seconds.
spells.tooltip: Ahri blows a kiss that deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Charms</status> the first enemy hit for {{ charmduration }} seconds. They also take {{ damageamp }}% more damage from her for {{ damageampduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spirit Rush
spells.description: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging 3 nearby enemies (prioritizes Champions). Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown.
spells.tooltip: Ahri nimbly dashes, firing 3 essence bolts at nearby enemies, prioritizing champions. These bolts deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> each. <spellName>Spirit Rush</spellName> can be <recast>Recast</recast> up to 2 more times within {{ recastduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Essence Theft
passive.description: Gains a charge of Essence Theft whenever a spell hits an enemy. Upon reaching maximum charges, the next spell restores Ahri's Health.

Jade_Akali.name: Akali
Jade_Akali.title: The Fist of Shadow
Jade_Akali.lore:
- Akali's Passive provides bonuses based on bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power
- Akali's Q is a targetted ability
- Akali's E does AOE damage around her
- Akali's R is a targetted dash
Jade_Akali.blurb:
- Akali's Passive provides bonuses based on bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power
- Akali's Q is a targetted ability
- Akali's E does AOE damage around her
- Akali's R is a targetted dash

spells.name: Mark of the Assassin
spells.description: Akali spins her kama at a target enemy to deal magic damage and mark the target. Akali's next melee attack against a marked target will consume the mark to cause additional damage and restore Energy.
spells.tooltip:
Akali throws her kama at a target enemy to deal {{ initialdamage }} magic damage and mark the target for {{ markduration }} seconds.

Akali's melee attacks against a marked target will consume the mark to cause {{ procdamage }} magic damage and restore {{ energyreturn }} Energy.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Twilight Shroud
spells.description: Akali throws down a cover of smoke. While inside the area, Akali gains Armor and Magic Resist and becomes invisible. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her. Enemies inside the smoke have their Movement Speed reduced.
spells.tooltip:
Akali throws down a cover of smoke that lasts for {{ cloudduration }} seconds. While inside the area, Akali gains {{ totalresists }} Armor and {{ totalresists }} Magic Resist and becomes Invisible. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.

Enemies inside the smoke are Slowed by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Crescent Slash
spells.description: Akali flourishes her kamas, dealing damage based on her Attack Damage and Ability Power.
spells.tooltip: Akali flourishes her kamas, slicing nearby enemies for <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shadow Dance
spells.description: Akali moves through shadows to quickly strike her target, dealing damage and consuming an Essence of Shadow charge. Akali recharges Essence of Shadow charges both periodically and upon kills and assists, max 3 stacks.
spells.tooltip:
Akali moves through shadows to quickly strike her target, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Akali stores an Essence of Shadow on kills and assists as well as every {{ ammorechargetime }} seconds up to 3 total.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Twin Disciplines
passive.description:
Gain damage on hit based on ability power
Gain spell vamp based on attack damage

Jade_Alistar.name: Alistar
Jade_Alistar.title: The Minotaur
Jade_Alistar.lore:
- Trample (P) and Triumphant Roar (E) have swapped
- Can build Ability Power
- Can solo lane
Jade_Alistar.blurb:
- Trample (P) and Triumphant Roar (E) have swapped
- Can build Ability Power
- Can solo lane

spells.name: Pulverize
spells.description: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to all nearby enemies and tossing them into the air. On landing, enemies are stunned.
spells.tooltip: Alistar smashes the ground, <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies for {{ knockupduration }} second and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Headbutt
spells.description: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.
spells.tooltip: Alistar rams into an enemy, <status>Knocking</status> them <status>Back</status> and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Triumphant Roar
spells.description: Alistar lets out a commanding war cry, restoring health to himself and nearby allies. Nearby enemy deaths reduce the cooldown.
spells.tooltip:
Alistar roars restoring {{ totalheal }} Health to Alistar and {{ allyheal }} Health to nearby allies.

Nearby enemy deaths reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ nearbydeathcdr }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Unbreakable Will
spells.description: Alistar lets out a wild roar, gaining bonus damage, removing all crowd-control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.
spells.tooltip: Alistar immediately cleanses all <status>Disabling</status> effects, gains <physicalDamage>{{ bonusdamage }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> and takes {{ rdamagereduction }}% reduced damage for {{ rduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Trample
passive.description: Each time Alistar casts a spell, he Tramples nearby units and turrets for a few seconds, dealing damage to units he walks over.

Jade_Amumu.name: Amumu
Jade_Amumu.title: The Sad Mummy
Jade_Amumu.lore:
- Bandage Toss (Q) doesn't have extra charges
- Cursed Touch (P) reduces magic resist on basic attacks only
Jade_Amumu.blurb:
- Bandage Toss (Q) doesn't have extra charges
- Cursed Touch (P) reduces magic resist on basic attacks only

spells.name: Bandage Toss
spells.description: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.
spells.tooltip: Amumu launches a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, <status>Stunning</status> them for {{ stunduration }} second, and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Despair
spells.description: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum health each second.
spells.tooltip: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Amumu begins crying, dealing <magicDamage>{{ basedamage }} plus {{ totalhealthdamage }}% max health magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies each second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tantrum
spells.description: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Amumu takes {{ passivedamagereduction }} reduced physical damage.

Active: Amumu deals {{ tantrumdamage }} magic damage to surrounding units. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced by {{ cooldownreduction }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
spells.description: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his <keywordMajor>Curse</keywordMajor>, damaging and stunning them.
spells.tooltip: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units, dealing <magicDamage>{{ rcalculateddamage }} Magic Damage</magicDamage> and preventing attacks and movement for {{ debuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Cursed Touch
passive.description: Amumu's attacks reduce his target's Magic Resist.

Jade_Anivia.name: Anivia
Jade_Anivia.title: The Cryopheonix
Jade_Anivia.lore:
- Frostbite (E) doesn't have Chill passive
- Glacial Storm (R) slow also affects attack speed
Jade_Anivia.blurb:
- Frostbite (E) doesn't have Chill passive
- Glacial Storm (R) slow also affects attack speed

spells.name: Flash Frost
spells.description: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.
spells.tooltip:
A massive chunk of ice flies toward target location, dealing {{ totalpassthroughdamage }} magic damage and chilling targets, Slowing their Movement Speed by {{ movementspeedmod*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

At the end of its range or if Anivia recasts the spell, the missile detonates, doing {{ totalexplosiondamage }} magic damage in a small area and Stunning units for {{ stunduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Crystallize
spells.description: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.
spells.tooltip: Anivia summons an impassable wall of ice {{ wallwidth }} units wide, blocking all movement. The wall lasts for {{ wallduration }} seconds before it melts.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.description: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing a medium amount of damage. If the target has been slowed by an ice effect, the damage they take is doubled.
spells.tooltip: Anivia blasts her target with a freezing wind, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.  If the target is chilled, they take <magicDamage>{{ empowereddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Glacial Storm
spells.description: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.
spells.tooltip: <toggle>Toggle: </toggle>Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagepersecond }} magic damage</magicDamage> per second and chilling targets, <status>Slowing</status> their Attack and Movement Speed by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
spells.resource: {{ cost }} Mana + {{ manacostpersecond }} Mana per second

passive.name: Rebirth
passive.description: Upon dying, Anivia will revert into an egg. If the egg can survive, she is gloriously reborn.

Jade_Annie.name: Annie
Jade_Annie.title: The Dark Child
Jade_Annie.lore:
- Tibbers (R) dies when Annie does
- Pyromania (P) Stacks reset on death
- Molten Shield (E) doesn't grant movement speed
Jade_Annie.blurb:
- Tibbers (R) dies when Annie does
- Pyromania (P) Stacks reset on death
- Molten Shield (E) doesn't grant movement speed

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.description: Annie hurls a mana-infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the mana cost if it destroys the target.
spells.tooltip: Annie hurls a ball of fire dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Mana cost is refunded if <spellName>Disintegrate</spellName> kills the target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Incinerate
spells.description: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.
spells.tooltip: Annie casts a cone of fire dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to all enemies in the area.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Molten Shield
spells.description: Increases Annie's Armor and Magic Resist and damages enemies who hit Annie with basic attacks.
spells.tooltip: Annie surrounds herself in a flame barrier, increasing her <scaleArmor>Armor </scaleArmor>and <scaleMR>Magic Resist by {{ resistances }}</scaleMR> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. Enemies who attack Annie are dealt <magicDamage>{{ damagereturn }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Summon: Tibbers
spells.description: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.
spells.tooltip:
Tibbers appears in a burst of flame dealing {{ initialburstdamage }} magic damage to enemies in the target area.

For the next {{ tibberslifetime }} seconds, Tibbers chases down enemies and deals {{ tibbersauradamage }} magic damage each second to nearby foes.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Pyromania
passive.description: Annie's offensive spells occasionally Stuns her target(s).

Jade_Ashe.name: Ashe
Jade_Ashe.title: The Frost Archer
Jade_Ashe.lore:
- Frost Shot (Q) toggles slowing basic attacks
- Focus (P) builds up critical strikes out of combat
- Hawkshot (E) grants bonus gold on kill
Jade_Ashe.blurb:
- Frost Shot (Q) toggles slowing basic attacks
- Focus (P) builds up critical strikes out of combat
- Hawkshot (E) grants bonus gold on kill

spells.name: Frost Shot
spells.description: While active, each of Ashe's basic attacks slow her targets. This drains Mana with each attack.
spells.tooltip: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Basic Attacks <status>Slow</status> enemies by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% over {{ slowduration }} seconds.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Volley
spells.description: Ashe fires 7 arrows in a cone for increased damage.  Volley also applies Ashe's current level of Frost Shot.
spells.tooltip: Fires arrows in a cone, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. <spellName>Volley</spellName> applies <spellName>Frost Shot's</spellName> <status>Slow</status> effect.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hawkshot
spells.description: Each time Ashe kills a unit, she gains some extra gold. Ashe can activate to send her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Ashe gains {{ additionalgold }} extra gold whenever she kills an enemy.

Active: Ashe sends forth a hawk to grant vision in an area for {{ revealduration }} seconds. It also reveals the area as it flies through.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
spells.description: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line.  If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion for up to 3.5 seconds, based on how far the arrow has traveled.  In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.
spells.tooltip: Ashe launches a crystal arrow of ice in a line that <status>Stuns</status> an enemy Champion dealing <magicDamage>{{ rmaindamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. <status>Stun</status> duration increases with distance travelled, up to {{ maxstunduration }} seconds. Surrounding enemies are <status>Slowed</status> by {{ movementspeedmod*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds and take <magicDamage>{{ raoedamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Focus
passive.description: Ashe gains stacks of <spellName>Focus</spellName> while out-of-combat. When Ashe has 100 stacks of <spellName>Focus</spellName>, her next basic Attack will critically strike.

Jade_Blitzcrank.name: Blitzcrank
Jade_Blitzcrank.title: The Great Steam Golem
Jade_Blitzcrank.lore: - Static Field (R) passive zaps nearby enemies
Jade_Blitzcrank.blurb: - Static Field (R) passive zaps nearby enemies

spells.name: Rocket Grab
spells.description: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.
spells.tooltip: Blitzcrank fires their right hand, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Stuns</status> the target and <status>Pulling</status> them to themself.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Overdrive
spells.description: Blitzcrank supercharges themself to get dramatically increased movement and attack speed.
spells.tooltip: Blitzcrank supercharges themself to increase <speed>Movement Speed</speed> by {{ movespeedmod*100 }}% and <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> by {{ attackspeedmod*100 }}% for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Power Fist
spells.description: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make their next attack deal bonus damage and pop their target up in the air.
spells.tooltip: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make their next attack deal <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Knock Up</status> their target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Static Field
spells.description: Passively causes lightning bolts to damage a nearby enemy. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to damage nearby enemies and briefly silence them.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Lightning arcs off of Blitzcrank to hit a random nearby enemy for {{ passivedamage }} magic damage every {{ passivehitrate }} seconds.

Active: Deals {{ activedamage }} magic damage and Silences surrounding enemy units for {{ silenceduration }} seconds. The passive is disabled while Static Field is on cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Mana Barrier
passive.description: When taking damage at low Health, Blitzcrank is first Shielded for a percent of their current Mana. This effect has a cooldown.

spells.name: Sear
spells.description: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.
spells.tooltip:
Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Blaze: If the target is Ablaze, Sear will Stun the target for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Pillar of Flame
spells.description: After a short delay, Brand creates a pillar of flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units with the area. Units that are ablaze take additional damage
spells.tooltip:
After a short delay, Brand creates a pillar of flame at a target area, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemy units within the area.

Blaze: Pillar of Flame deals {{ empowereddamage }} magic damage to units that are Ablaze instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Conflagration
spells.description: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing magic damage to them. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration spreads to nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Blaze: If the target is Ablaze, Conflagration spreads to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Pyroclasm
spells.description: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire, dealing magic damage each time it bounces. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will priotize champions for the next bounce.
spells.tooltip:
Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage each time it bounces up to {{ bounces }} bounces.

Blaze: If a target is Ablaze, Pyroclasm will prioritize champions for the next bounce.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Blaze
passive.description: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing a portion of their maximum Health in magic damage.

Jade_Chogath.name: Cho'Gath
Jade_Chogath.title: The Terror of the Void
Jade_Chogath.lore:
- Feast (R) stacks max 6 times, is lost on kill but can be stacked on anything
- Vorpal Spikes (E) toggles the spikes that go through players
Jade_Chogath.blurb:
- Feast (R) stacks max 6 times, is lost on kill but can be stacked on anything
- Vorpal Spikes (E) toggles the spikes that go through players

spells.name: Rupture
spells.description: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.
spells.tooltip: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground, <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies for {{ knockupduration }} second, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, and <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ slowamountpercentage }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Feral Scream
spells.description: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.
spells.tooltip: Cho'Gath roars, <status>Silencing</status> enemies for {{ silenceduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Vorpal Spikes
spells.description: Cho'Gath's attacks passively release deadly spikes, dealing damage to all enemy units in front of him.
spells.tooltip: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Cho'gath's attacks launch spikes that deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Feast
spells.description: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum health (maximum 6 stacks). Cho'Gath loses half of his stacks upon death.
spells.tooltip: Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing <trueDamage>{{ rdamage }} true damage</trueDamage> to champions or <trueDamage>{{ rmonsterdamage }}</trueDamage> to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain <healing>{{ rhealthperstack }} max Health</healing> (maximum 6 stacks). Loses half of his stacks on death. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Carnivore
passive.description: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers health and mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.

Jade_Corki.name: Corki
Jade_Corki.title: The Daring Bombardier
Jade_Corki.lore: - Phosphorus Bomb (Q) is an instant explosion
Jade_Corki.blurb: - Phosphorus Bomb (Q) is an instant explosion

spells.name: Phosphorus Bomb
spells.description: Corki fires a bomb, damaging and revealing enemies around the blast.
spells.tooltip: Corki fires a bomb, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. The area and champions hit are revealed for {{ revealduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Valkyrie
spells.description: Corki surges to target location, dropping bombs that create a trail of destruction for opponents who remain in the fire.
spells.tooltip: Corki surges to target location, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage </magicDamage>per second to enemies in the fire left along his path.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Gatling Gun
spells.description: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy armor.
spells.tooltip: Corki's gatling gun fires in a cone in front of him for {{ activeduration }} seconds, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ damagepersecondcalc }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>reducing {{ armormod*-1 }} armor</status> per second. The armor reduction stacks and lasts {{ shredduration }} seconds. (Maximum damage: <physicalDamage>{{ maximumdamagetooltip }}</physicalDamage>){{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Missile Barrage
spells.description: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Some missiles will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.
spells.tooltip:
Corki fires a missile toward his targeted location that will collide with the first enemy it hits. Each missile deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage in an area.

This Ability has {{ maxammotooltip }} charges ({{ ammorechargetime }} second refresh).

Every 3rd missile will be a Big One, dealing {{ totaldamagebig }} magic damage instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Hextech Shrapnel Shells
passive.description: Corki's basic attacks deal bonus true damage to minions, monsters, and champions.

Jade_DrMundo.name: Dr. Mundo
Jade_DrMundo.title: The Madman of Zaun
Jade_DrMundo.lore:
- Burning Agony (W) is a toggle of damage AoE around him
- Masochism (E) is a buff for a time not an attack
- Adrenaline Rush (P) regenerates health over time
Jade_DrMundo.blurb:
- Burning Agony (W) is a toggle of damage AoE around him
- Masochism (E) is a buff for a time not an attack
- Adrenaline Rush (P) regenerates health over time

spells.name: Infected Cleaver
spells.description: Dr. Mundo hurls his cleaver, dealing damage based on his victims maximum health.
spells.tooltip:
Dr. Mundo hurls his cleaver, dealing magic damage equal to {{ damagemod*100 }}% of the target's current health ({{ mindamage }} damage minimum) and Slowing them by {{ movemod*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

{{ healthreturn }} Health is refunded if the cleaver hits a target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Burning Agony
spells.description: Dr. Mundo drains his health to reduce the duration of disables and deal continual damage to nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip: <toggle>Toggle: </toggle>Dr. Mundo deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies, and reduces the duration of disables on Dr. Mundo by {{ durationmod*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Masochism
spells.description: Dr. Mundo's gains Attack Damage for a few seconds based on his missing health.
spells.tooltip: Dr. Mundo gains <physicalDamage>{{ baseincrease }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for {{ duration }} seconds. Dr. Mundo gains an additional <physicalDamage>+{{ damagemod }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for each percentage of Health he is missing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Sadism
spells.description: Dr. Mundo sacrifices a portion of his Health for increased Movement Speed and drastically increased Health Regeneration.
spells.tooltip: Dr. Mundo regenerates <healing>{{ maximumhealthregen }} Health</healing> and gains <speed>{{ speedmod*100 }}% Movement Speed</speed> over {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Adrenaline Rush
passive.description: Dr. Mundo regenerates a portion of his maximum Health each second.

Jade_Evelynn.name: Evelynn
Jade_Evelynn.title: The Widowmaker
Jade_Evelynn.lore:
- The Abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions
- Fighter not an Assassin
Jade_Evelynn.blurb:
- The Abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions
- Fighter not an Assassin

spells.name: Hate Spike
spells.description: Evelynn fires a line of spikes through an enemy, dealing damage to all enemies in its path.
spells.tooltip:
Evelynn fires a line of spikes through a nearby enemy dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to all enemies in its path.

Hate Spike prioritizes targets Evelynn has recently attacked.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dark Frenzy
spells.description: Evelynn passively increases her Movement Speed when hitting enemy champions with her spells. Upon activation, Evelynn breaks free from slows affecting her and gains a massive Movement Speed boost for a short duration.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Evelynn's spell hits on enemy champions grant her {{ passivems }} Movement Speed for {{ passiveduration }} seconds (effect stacks up to {{ maxpassivestacks }} times).

Active: Evelynn removes all slows affecting her and gains {{ activems*100 }}% Movement Speed for {{ activeduration }} seconds.

Champion takedowns refresh Dark Frenzy's cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ravage
spells.description: Evelynn slashes her target twice, dealing damage with each hit. She then gains increased Attack Speed for a short duration.
spells.tooltip: Evelynn slashes a target {{ numberofstrikes }} times, dealing a total of <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Evelynn then gains <attackSpeed>{{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Agony's Embrace
spells.description: Evelynn summons spikes from the ground to deal damage and slow enemies in the area. She then gains a shield based on how many enemy champions were hit.
spells.tooltip:
Evelynn impales all enemies in the targeted area, dealing {{ totaldamage }}% current Health magic damage and Slowing them by {{ slow*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

spells.description: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.

Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity, gaining a charge whenever a spell is cast near him.

spells.name: Riftwalk
spells.description: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Additionally, multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana and deal additional damage.

passive.name: Void Stone
passive.description: Kassadin takes reduced <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> and transforms incoming magic damage into bonus <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed>.

Jade_Katarina.name: Katarina
Jade_Katarina.title: The Sinister Blade
Jade_Katarina.lore:
- Bouncing Blades (Q) deals damage and marks enemies, Katarina can consume the mark with spells or attacks to deal extra magic damage.
- Sinister Steel (W) does damage around Katarina and increases her movement speed if the ability hits a champion.
- Shunpo (E) deals damage and blinks to target; afterwards the ability provides damage reduction to Katarina.
Jade_Katarina.blurb:
- Bouncing Blades (Q) deals damage and marks enemies, Katarina can consume the mark with spells or attacks to deal extra magic damage.
- Sinister Steel (W) does damage around Katarina and increases her movement speed if the ability hits a champion...

spells.name: Bouncing Blade
spells.description: Katarina throws a dagger that bounces from enemy to enemy, dealing magic damage.
spells.tooltip:
Throws a dagger dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. The dagger bounces to the {{ maxbounces }} closest enemies dealing {{ damagefalloff*100 }}% less damage with each bounce.

Enemies hit are marked for {{ markduration }} seconds. Katarina's basic attacks or spells will consume the mark dealing {{ totaldamagemark }} additional magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Sinister Steel
spells.description: Katarina whirls her daggers around her, dealing magic damage to all enemies in the area. If she hits an enemy Champion, Katarina gains a burst of speed for a short duration.
spells.tooltip: Whirls daggers in a circle dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. If she hits an enemy Champion, Katarina gains {{ haste*100 }}%  <speed>Movement Speed</speed> for {{ buffduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shunpo
spells.description: Katarina instantly moves to her target's location and takes reduced damage from enemies for a few seconds. If the target is an enemy, she deals damage.
spells.tooltip:
Moves to a target's location. Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage if the target is an enemy.

After using Shunpo, Katarina takes {{ damagereduction }}% reduced damage for {{ damagereductionduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Death Lotus
spells.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers with unrivaled speed at nearby enemy Champions, dealing significant damage and applying Wounds.
spells.tooltip: Becomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers at the closest {{ maxtargets }} enemy Champions dealing <magicDamage>{{ damagecalctooltiponly }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ channelduration }} seconds. Enemies struck are <status>Wounded</status> by {{ grievouswoundsamount*100 }}% for {{ grievouswoundsduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Voracity
passive.description: Champion takedowns reduce Katarina's cooldowns.

Jade_Kayle.name: Kayle
Jade_Kayle.title: The Judicator

- The Abilities are completely different, except for Divine Blessing (W)
- Leveling up doesn't change her attacks
- Holy Fervor (P) grants Attack Damage as Ability Power and vice versa

- The Abilities are completely different, except for Divine Blessing (W)
- Leveling up doesn't change her attacks

spells.name: Reckoning
spells.description: Kayle blasts a target, dealing damage, slowing their movement speed, and applying a stack of Holy Fervor.
spells.tooltip: Kayle blasts a target, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> while <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowpercent }}% and increasing Kayle's damage to them by {{ damageamp*100 }}% for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Divine Blessing
spells.description: Kayle blesses an allied champion, increasing their movement speed and healing them.
spells.tooltip: Kayle blesses an allied champion, increasing their <speed>Movement Speed</speed> by {{ movespeed*100 }}% for {{ duration }} seconds and healing them for <healing>{{ totalheal }} health</healing>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Righteous Fury
spells.description: Kayle increases her attack range and her basic attacks deals additional damage to her target and nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip: Kayle increases her attack range by {{ bonusrange }} for {{ duration }} seconds and her basic attacks deal <magicDamage>{{ targetdamage }} additional magic damage</magicDamage> on-hit. Nearby enemies take <magicDamage>{{ splashdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> on attack.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Intervention
spells.description: Bathes Kayle's target in a holy light, rendering them immune to all damage for a short time.
spells.tooltip: Kayle bathes an allied champion in holy light, making them Invulnerable for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Holy Fervor
passive.description: Kayle gains a percentage of her Ability Power as Attack damage and a percentage of her Attack Damage as Ability Power.

Jade_Kennen.name: Kennen

Jade_Kennen.lore:
- Kennen's E provides defensive bonuses instead of Attack Speed
- Kennen's R randomly strikes nearby champions
Jade_Kennen.blurb:
- Kennen's E provides defensive bonuses instead of Attack Speed
- Kennen's R randomly strikes nearby champions

spells.name: Thundering Shuriken
spells.description: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of Storm to any opponent that it hits.
spells.tooltip: Kennen throws a shuriken that damages the first enemy hit dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Electrical Surge
spells.description: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Every {{ passivehitsrequired }} attacks, Kennen deals {{ totaldamagepassive }} magic damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target.

Active: Surges electricity through all nearby targets afflicted by Mark of the Storm, dealing {{ totaldamageactive }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Lightning Rush
spells.description: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units.  Any enemy unit he runs through takes damage and gets a Mark of the Storm.
spells.tooltip:
Kennen turns into a ball of lightning gaining {{ movementspeed*100 }}% Move Speed, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to any enemy he passes through, and becomes Ghosted for {{ durationasball }} seconds. Additionally, Kennen will gain {{ resists }} Armor and {{ resists }} Magic Resist for {{ resistancesduration }} seconds.

Kennen is refunded {{ energyrefund }} Energy if he passes through an enemy, but can only gain this effect once. This ability deals half damage to minions ({{ totalminiondamage }}).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Slicing Maelstrom
spells.description: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at random nearby enemy champions for magical damage.
spells.tooltip: Summons a magical storm for {{ jade_kennenrduration }} seconds, dealing <magicDamage>{{ pertickdamagecalculated }} magic damage</magicDamage> to a random enemy champion near Kennen every {{ jade_kennenrtickrate }} seconds. This storm cannot hit the same target more than {{ maximumhitspercast }} times.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Mark of the Storm
passive.description: Kennen marks enemies when hitting them with abilities. Once three marks are applied the target is stunned.

Jade_KogMaw.name: Kog'Maw
Jade_KogMaw.title: The Mouth of the Abyss

Jade_KogMaw.blurb: - Caustic Spittle (Q) is point and click

spells.name: Caustic Spittle
spells.description: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile that damages his target and corrodes their Armor and Magic Resist.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Kog'Maw gains {{ passiveattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed.

Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds {{ armorshred }} Armor and Magic Resist for {{ debuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
spells.description: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage.
spells.tooltip: Kog'Maw gains {{ range }} Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional <magicDamage>{{ totalhealthdamage }} max Health magic damage</magicDamage> <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Void Ooze
spells.description: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.
spells.tooltip: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and leaves a trail of ooze for {{ trailduration }} seconds. Enemies in the ooze are <status>Slowed</status> by {{ slowamount*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Living Artillery
spells.description: Kog'Maw fires a living artillery shell at a great distance dealing damage and revealing targets.  Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional mana.
spells.tooltip:
Kog'Maw shoots acid from a great distance that lands shortly after launch. Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage , increased to {{ championtotaldamage }} magic damage to Champions and reveals enemies for {{ visiondebuffduration }} seconds.

Subsequent artillery shots within {{ manacostduration }} seconds cost {{ basecost }} additional Mana (max: {{ manacostcap }} Mana).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Icathian Surprise
passive.description: Upon dying, Kog'Maw starts a chain reaction in his body which causes him to detonate after a few seconds, damaging surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
spells.description:
Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, damaging the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike.

Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing more damage plus a portion of their missing health.
spells.tooltip:
Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing {{ initialdamage }} physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.

spells.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
spells.description:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes towards a target ally, shielding them both from damage. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.

Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle, gaining Life Steal, Spell Vamp, and Armor.
spells.tooltip:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes towards a target ally, shielding them both for {{ shieldamount }} damage over the next {{ shieldduration }} seconds. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will for the next {{ w1reactivatetime }} seconds.

Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. For {{ lifestealandspellvamptime }} seconds, Lee Sin gains {{ lifestealandspellvamp }}% Life Steal, Spell Vamp, and {{ armorbonus }} Armor.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tempest / Cripple
spells.description:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple for the next 3 seconds.
Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies revealed by Tempest, reducing their Movement and Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Movement and Attack Speed recover gradually over the duration.
spells.tooltip:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals {{ initialdamage }} magic damage and reveals enemy units hit for 4 seconds. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast Cripple for the next 3 seconds.

label: Tempest Damage
Cripple Movement and Attack Speed % reduction

spells.name: Dragon's Rage
spells.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. spells.tooltip: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick <status>Knocking</status> an enemy champion back, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ damage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are <status>Knocked</status> into the air for a short duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Flurry
passive.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

spells.tooltip: The next basic attack deals an additional <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stuns</status> an enemy for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

This ability gains damage equal to {{ armorscaling_jade*100 }}% of Malphite's Armor.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Unstoppable Force
spells.description: Malphite ferociously charges to a location, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
spells.tooltip: Malphite charges toward the target area, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Knocking</status> enemies into the air for {{ knockupduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Double Up
spells.description: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them.
spells.tooltip: Miss Fortune fires a shot at an enemy target, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and <physicalDamage>{{ totalricochetdamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to another enemy target behind the first. Applies on-hit effects.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Impure Shots
spells.description: Miss Fortune passively increases damage dealt to a target with each strike.  This ability can be activated to increase Miss Fortune's Attack Speed and cause her attacks to lower healing received by the target.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Miss Fortune deals {{ totaldamageonhit }} magic damage to her target with each attack, cumulatively stacking up to {{ maxstacks }} times on the same target.
Maximum bonus damage: {{ maximumtotaldamageonhit }}

Active: Miss Fortune's Attack Speed is increased by {{ asmod }}% for {{ activeduration }} seconds and causes her attacks to apply 50% Grievous Wounds for 3 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Make It Rain
spells.description: Miss Fortune unleashes a flurry of bullets at a location, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.
spells.tooltip: Miss Fortune fires hundreds of bullets into the air that rain down, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ duration }} seconds and <status>Slowing</status> enemies by {{ movespeedmod*-100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bullet Time
spells.description: Miss Fortune channels a flurry of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies.
spells.tooltip: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her for {{ channelduration }} seconds, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ physicaldamageperwave }} physical damage</physicalDamage> per bullet (<physicalDamage>Total Damage: {{ totaldamage }}</physicalDamage>).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Strut
passive.description: Miss Fortune has increased Movement Speed until she is hit in combat.

spells.name: Dark Binding
spells.description: Morgana releases a sphere of dark magic.  Upon contact with an enemy unit, the sphere will deal magic damage and force the unit to the ground for a period of time.
spells.tooltip: Fires a bolt of dark energy, <status>Rooting</status> the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} seconds, and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage.</magicDamage></mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tormented Soil
spells.description: Infects an area with desecrated soil, causing enemy units who stand on the location to take continual damage.
spells.tooltip: Curses an area for {{ duration }} seconds. Enemies on the cursed ground take <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and have their <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> reduced by {{ mrshredtooltip }} every second.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Black Shield
spells.description: Places a protective barrier around an allied champion, absorbing magical damage and disables until penetrated or the shield dissipates.
spells.tooltip: Shields an allied Champion for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. The shield absorbs <shield>{{ totalshieldstrength }}</shield> <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> and prevents <status>Disables</status> until it breaks.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Soul Shackles
spells.description: Latches chains of energy onto nearby enemy champions, dealing initial damage to them and slowing their Movement Speed, and then echoing the pain a few seconds later and stunning them if they remain close to Morgana.
spells.tooltip:
Dark chains latch onto nearby enemy Champions dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}%. After {{ chainduration }} seconds, they are dealt an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and are stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds.

Enemy Champions can break the chains by moving away from Morgana.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Soul Siphon
passive.description: Morgana has Spell Vamp, healing herself whenever she deals damage with her spells.

Jade_Nasus.name: Nasus
Jade_Nasus.title: The Curator of the Sands
Jade_Nasus.lore: - Fury of the Sands (R) magic damage temporarily converts a percentage into Attack Damage
Jade_Nasus.blurb: - Fury of the Sands (R) magic damage temporarily converts a percentage into Attack Damage

spells.name: Siphoning Strike
spells.description: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.
spells.tooltip: Nasus's next Attack deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by {{ basicstacks }}, increased to {{ bigstacks }} against champions, large minions and large monsters.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wither
spells.description: Nasus ages his target, decelerating their Movement and Attack Speeds over time.
spells.tooltip: Nasus ages target champion over {{ duration }} seconds, initially <status>Slowing</status> their Movement Speed by {{ slowbase }}% increasing to {{ maxslowtooltiponly }}% and Attack Speed by {{ attackspeedbasetotal }}% increasing to {{ attackspeedmaxtotal }}%  over the duration.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spirit Fire
spells.description: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.
spells.tooltip:
Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a target location, dealing an initial {{ initialdamage }} magic damage.

For the next {{ duration }} seconds, enemies in the area have their Armor reduced by {{ totalarmorshred }} and are dealt an additional {{ tickdotdamage }} magic damage each second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Fury of the Sands
spells.description: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, cast ranges, and drains nearby enemies' max Health converting into bonus damage for the duration.
spells.tooltip:
Nasus becomes empowered in the sandstorm for {{ duration }} seconds, increasing his Maximum Health by {{ bonushealth }}, Attack Range by {{ attackrangeincrease }}, and Cast Ranges by 100.

While the storm rages, he deals {{ damagecalc }} of enemy Maximum Health magic damage ({{ maxdamagecap }} damage max per second) and converts {{ damagetoad*100 }}% into bonus Attack Damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Soul Eater
passive.description: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Lifesteal.

Jade_Nidalee.name: Nidalee
Jade_Nidalee.title: The Bestial Huntress
Jade_Nidalee.lore:
- Aspect of the Cougar (R) does not start with a level
- Prowl (P) has Hunt passive removed
- Bushwhack (W) does insane damage
Jade_Nidalee.blurb:
- Aspect of the Cougar (R) does not start with a level
- Prowl (P) has Hunt passive removed
- Bushwhack (W) does insane damage

spells.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
spells.description: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies.  As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.
spells.tooltip:
Human: Nidalee tosses her javelin, dealing between {{ startingdamage }} and {{ maxdamage }} magic damage on impact based on how far Nidalee is away from the target.

Cougar: Nidalee's next attack deals between {{ spell.jade_nidaleeaspectofthecougar:totaltakedowndamage }} and {{ spell.jade_nidaleeaspectofthecougar:totaltakedownmaximumdamage }} physical damage based on the target's missing Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
spells.description: In human form, Nidalee lays a damaging trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages, reveals, reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist. As a cougar, she pounces forward, dealing a small amount of damage when she lands.
spells.tooltip:
Human: Nidalee lays a trap that deals {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage over {{ damageduration }} seconds, reveals the target, and shreds their Armor and Magic Resist by {{ resistdecreases*100 }}% for {{ shredduration }} seconds. Traps last for {{ trapdurationmins }} minutes.

Cougar: Nidalee lunges forward, dealing {{ spell.jade_nidaleeaspectofthecougar:totalpouncedamage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
spells.description: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with attack speed for a short duration.  As a cougar, she rapidly claws enemies in front of her.
spells.tooltip:
Human: Nidalee heals an allied champion for {{ totalhealing }} and grants them {{ bonusas*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ asduration }} seconds.

Cougar: Nidalee claws at enemies in front of her, dealing {{ spell.jade_nidaleeaspectofthecougar:totalswipedamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
spells.description: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities and increased Movement Speed.
spells.tooltip:
Human: Nidalee transforms into a vicious cougar, gaining {{ cougarmovespeed }} Movement Speed, and her basic abilities become Takedown, Pounce, and Swipe.

Cougar: Nidalee transforms back into human form.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Prowl
passive.description: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Movement Speed.

Jade_Nunu.name: Nunu & Willump
Jade_Nunu.title: The Yeti Rider
Jade_Nunu.lore:
- Blood Boil (W) grants attack and movement speed
- Ice Blast (E) a single point and click snowball
- Consume (Q) can't target champions but gain buffs based on whats eaten
- Visionary (P) every 5 basic attacks the next spell costs no mana - Nunu & Willump get an extra line as they are 2 characters
Jade_Nunu.blurb:
- Blood Boil (W) grants attack and movement speed
- Ice Blast (E) a single point and click snowball
- Consume (Q) can't target champions but gain buffs based on whats eaten
- Visionary (P) every 5 basic attacks the next spell costs no mana -...

spells.name: Consume
spells.description: Nunu commands the yeti to take a bite out of a target minion or monster, dealing heavy damage to it and healing himself.
spells.tooltip:
Commands the yeti to bite out of a minion or monster, dealing {{ basedamage }} true damage to the target and healing himself for {{ totalhealing }}.

Nunu gains bonuses for {{ consumeduration }} seconds based on what he consumed.

Wolves or Reptiles: Your attacks and spells deal an additional {{ reptiledamage }} magic damage.
Golems: {{ golemsizebonus*100 }}% increased Size and {{ golemhealthbonus*100 }}% Maximum Health.
Wraiths: Killing a unit grants {{ wraithmovespeed*100 }}% Movement Speed for {{ wraithmovespeedduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blood Boil
spells.description: Nunu invigorates himself and an allied unit by heating their blood, increasing their Movement and Attack Speeds.
spells.tooltip: The heat of Nunu and a target ally's blood rises, increasing <speed>Movement Speed by {{ movespeed*100 }}%</speed> and <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by {{ attackspeed*100 }}%</attackSpeed> for {{ buffduration }} seconds. Nunu may target themself.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ice Blast
spells.description: Nunu launches a ball of ice at an enemy unit, dealing damage and temporarily slowing their Movement and Attack Speeds.
spells.tooltip: Nunu launches a ball of ice at an enemy unit, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> their Movement Speed by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% and Attack Speed by {{ attackspeedmod*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.description: Nunu begins to sap the area of heat, slowing all nearby enemies. When the spell ends, he deals massive damage to all enemies caught in the area.
spells.tooltip:
Nunu saps the area of heat, channeling while enemies within the zone are Slowed by {{ movementspeedmod*-100 }}% and their Attack Speed is reduced by {{ attackspeedmod*-100 }}%.

Enemies caught in the area when the channel ends receive up to {{ totaldamage }} magic damage, depending on how long the spell was channeled.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Visionary
passive.description: Nunu can cast a spell for free after several attacks.

Jade_Olaf.name: Olaf
Jade_Olaf.title: The Berserker
Jade_Olaf.lore:
- Vicious Strikes (W) grants Attack Damage, Lifesteal and Spell Vamp
- Reckless Swing (E) does not heal the health cost
Jade_Olaf.blurb:
- Vicious Strikes (W) grants Attack Damage, Lifesteal and Spell Vamp
- Reckless Swing (E) does not heal the health cost

spells.name: Undertow
spells.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to units it passes through and slowing their movement speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reduced.
spells.tooltip:
Olaf throws an axe to a target location, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to units it passes through and Slowing them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% over {{ debuffduration }} seconds.

If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reduced by {{ cooldownrefund }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Vicious Strikes
spells.description: Olaf's attack damage is increased, based on his health, and he gains massive lifesteal and spell vamp.
spells.tooltip: Olaf gains <physicalDamage>{{ totaladgain }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> , {{ lifestealamount*100 }}% Lifesteal, and Spell Vamp for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Reckless Swing
spells.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself.
spells.tooltip: Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing <trueDamage>{{ totaldamage }} true damage</trueDamage> to his target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ragnarok
spells.description: Olaf temporarily becomes immune to disables and gains bonus Armor, Magic Resist, and Lethality.
spells.tooltip:
Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them the next {{ duration }} seconds. During this time, Olaf gains {{ resists }} Armor and {{ resists }} Magic Resist.

Passive: Olaf gains an additional {{ armorpen }} Lethality.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Berserker Rage
passive.description: Olaf's Attack Speed increases as his Health decreases.

Jade_Pantheon.name: Pantheon
Jade_Pantheon.title: The Artisan of War

skins.name: Chosen of the Wolf Pantheon (Rose Quartz)

Jade_Pantheon.lore:
- Aegis Protection (P) blocks damage after casting multiple times
- Grand Skyfall (R) is a circle AoE
- Heartseeker Strike (E) - Pantheon stands still and strikes
Jade_Pantheon.blurb:
- Aegis Protection (P) blocks damage after casting multiple times
- Grand Skyfall (R) is a circle AoE
- Heartseeker Strike (E) - Pantheon stands still and strikes

spells.name: Spear Shot
spells.description: Pantheon hurls his spear at an opponent, dealing damage.
spells.tooltip: Pantheon hurls his spear at an opponent, dealing<physicalDamage> {{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Aegis of Zeonia
spells.description: Pantheon leaps at an enemy and bashes the enemy with his shield, stunning them. After finishing the attack, Pantheon readies himself to block the next attack.
spells.tooltip: Pantheon leaps at the target enemy and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stuns</status> them for {{ stunduration }} second(s). Pantheon also instantly refreshes his <spellName>Aegis Protection</spellName>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Heartseeker Strike
spells.description: Pantheon focuses and unleashes swift strikes to the area in front of him, dealing increased damage to champions. Pantheon also becomes more aware of his enemy's vital spots, allowing him to critically strike against wounded enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Spear Shot, Heartseeker Strike, and Pantheon's basic attacks critically strike against targets below {{ passivecritthreshold*100 }}% health.

Active: Pantheon channels and deals {{ numberofstrikes }} swift strikes to the area in front of him for {{ totaldamage }} physical damage per strike (total {{ maximumdamagetooltip }}).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Grand Skyfall
spells.description: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air to a target, striking all enemy units in an area. Enemies closer to the impact point take more damage.
spells.tooltip: Pantheon gathers his strength and then leaps high into the air, crashing down at the target area a few seconds later. Deals up to <magicDamage>{{ maxdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to units at the center (down to <magicDamage>{{ mindamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> at the edge) and <status>Slows</status> them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Aegis Protection
passive.description: After every @AttacksRequired@ attacks or spell casts, Pantheon gains protection from the next attack.

Jade_Poppy.name: Poppy
Jade_Poppy.lore:
- Heroic Charge (E) uses ability power scaling
- Passive, Q, W, R are completely different. Read the ability descriptions
Jade_Poppy.blurb:
- Heroic Charge (E) uses ability power scaling
- Passive, Q, W, R are completely different. Read the ability descriptions

spells.name: Devastating Blow
spells.description: Poppy crushes her opponent, dealing attack damage plus a flat amount and 8% of her target's max health as bonus damage. The bonus damage cannot exceed a threshold based on rank.
spells.tooltip: Poppy's next attack deals <magicDamage>{{ flatdamagecalc }} + {{ healthratio*100 }}% maximum Health magic damage</magicDamage>. The percent health bonus damage cannot exceed {{ healthdamagecap }}.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Paragon of Demacia
spells.description: Passive: Upon receiving damage from or dealing damage with a basic attack, Poppy's armor and damage are increased for 5 seconds. This effect can stack 10 times. Active: Poppy gains max stacks of Paragon of Demacia and her movement speed is increased for 5 seconds.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Poppy gains {{ bonusstats }} Armor and Attack Damage for {{ passiveduration }} seconds whenever she deals or takes Attack damage. This effect can stack {{ maxstacks }} times.

Active: Poppy gains max stacks of Paragon of Demacia and her movement speed is increased by {{ speed*100 }}% for {{ activeduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Heroic Charge
spells.description: Poppy charges at an enemy and carries them further. The initial impact deals a small amount of damage, and if they collide with terrain, her target will take a high amount of damage and be stunned.
spells.tooltip: Poppy charges at an enemy, dealing <magicDamage>{{ initialdamagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and carrying them a short distance. If they collide with terrain, her target takes an additional <magicDamage>{{ walldamagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and will be <status>stunned</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Diplomatic Immunity
spells.description: Poppy focuses intently on a single enemy champion, dealing increased damage to them. Poppy is immune to any damage and abilities from enemies other than her target.
spells.tooltip: Poppy singles out her most important foe. For {{ duration }} seconds, Poppy deals {{ damagemulti }}% increased damage to them and is <status>Immune</status> to all other enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Valiant Fighter
passive.description: All physical and magic damage dealt to Poppy that exceeds 10% of her current health is reduced by 50%. This does not reduce damage from structures.

Jade_Rammus.name: Rammus
Jade_Rammus.title: The Armordillo
Jade_Rammus.lore:
- Tremors (R) is a repeating AoE around him
- All other abilities are ok
Jade_Rammus.blurb:
- Tremors (R) is a repeating AoE around him
- All other abilities are ok

spells.name: Powerball
spells.description: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.
spells.tooltip:
Rammus accelerates in a ball over {{ duration }}s towards his enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies on impact and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s.

Recast to remove this effect.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spells.description: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his armor and magic resistance, while returning damage to attacks.
spells.tooltip:
Rammus goes into a defensive formation for {{ duration }}s, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist by {{ armour }} and returning {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to attackers.

Recast to remove this effect.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Puncturing Taunt
spells.description: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against Rammus' hard shell, reducing Armor temporarily.
spells.tooltip: Rammus <status>Taunts</status> the enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault, reducing their Armor by {{ armourreduction*-1 }} and forcing them to attack Rammus for {{ duration }} second(s).</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tremors
spells.description: Rammus creates waves of destruction pulsing through the ground, causing damage to units and structures near him.
spells.tooltip: Rammus creates tremors beneath him, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> every second to nearby units and structures for {{ duration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Spiked Shell
passive.description: Rammus gains additional damage as his shell becomes reinforced, converting a portion of his Armor into Attack Damage.

Jade_Ryze.name: Ryze
Jade_Ryze.title: The Rogue Mage
Jade_Ryze.lore: - The Abilities are completely different (for the 5th time)
Jade_Ryze.blurb: - The Abilities are completely different (for the 5th time)

spells.name: Overload
spells.description:
Passive: Ryze permanently gains Cooldown Reduction.

Active: Ryze unleashes an orb of energy, dealing magic damage to his target.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Ryze permanently gains {{ passivecooldown*100 }}% Cooldown Reduction.

Active: Ryze unleashes an orb of energy, dealing {{ damagecalc }} magic damage to his target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rune Prison
spells.description: Ryze magically imprisons an enemy, <status>rooting</status> them and dealing <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage>.
spells.tooltip: Ryze magically imprisons an enemy, <status>rooting</status> them for {{ ccduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ damagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spell Flux
spells.description: Ryze fires a chaotic bolt of magic that can bounce between enemies, dealing <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> and reducing their <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.
spells.tooltip: Ryze fires a chaotic bolt of magic that can bounce between enemies or himself up to {{ maximumhits }} times, dealing <magicDamage>{{ damagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies and reducing their <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> by {{ resistshred }}.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Desperate Power
spells.description: Ryze temporary harnesses his full powers, gaining <magicDamage>area of effect damage</magicDamage> on all abilities, <healing>Spell Vamp</healing>, and <speed>Move Speed</speed> for a short time.
spells.tooltip: Ryze temporary harnesses his full powers, gaining <magicDamage>{{ areadamagemod*100 }}% area of effect damage</magicDamage> on all abilities, <healing>{{ spellvamp*100 }}% Spell Vamp</healing>, and <speed>{{ movementspeed }} Move Speed</speed> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Arcane Mastery
passive.description: Ryze's abilities reduce the cooldown of all other abilities.

Jade_Shaco.name: Shaco
Jade_Shaco.title: The Demon Jester
Jade_Shaco.lore:
- Hallucinate (R) clone explodes dealing more damage but doesn't spawn boxes
- Jack in the box (W) can be placed closer together
Jade_Shaco.blurb:
- Hallucinate (R) clone explodes dealing more damage but doesn't spawn boxes
- Jack in the box (W) can be placed closer together

spells.name: Deceive
spells.description: Shaco becomes invisible and teleports to target location. His next attack is guaranteed to critically strike.
spells.tooltip:
Shaco teleports nearby and becomes Invisible for {{ stealthduration }} seconds.

His next basic attack within the next {{ enhancedattackduration }} seconds will critically strike for {{ modifiedqcritdamagetooltip }} damage.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Jack In The Box
spells.description: Shaco creates an animated Jack-in-the-Box at target location, which will wait, invisible, to Fear nearby units and attack them when some come nearby.
spells.tooltip:
Shaco creates a trap that becomes Invisible after {{ stealthtimer }} seconds and lasts for {{ trapduration }} seconds. It activates when an enemy comes near Fearing nearby enemies for {{ fearduration }} seconds.

Once activated, the trap fires at nearby enemies for {{ traptriggeredlifetime }} seconds, dealing {{ boxtotaldamage_jade }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Two-Shiv Poison
spells.description: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing them and applying a miss chance to minions. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: While this Ability is off Cooldown, Shaco's Attacks Slow the target by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ slowdurationpassive }} seconds. Also reduces minions' chance to hit by {{ misschance*100 }}% for {{ slowdurationpassive }} seconds.

Active: Shaco throws a shiv, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to target enemy and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ slowdurationactive }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hallucinate
spells.description: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies. Upon death, it explodes, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Shaco vanishes briefly and reappears with a clone that lasts up to {{ clonelifetime }} seconds. The clone deals {{ cloneaadamagepercent*100 }}% of Shaco's damage and receives {{ clonebonusdamagetakentooltip }} increased damage.

On death, the clone detonates, dealing {{ explosiontotaldamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Backstab
passive.description: Shaco's Attacks and abilities deal bonus damage from behind.

Jade_Shen.name: Shen
Jade_Shen.title: Eye of Twilight
Jade_Shen.lore:
- Ki Strike (Passive) and Vorpal Blade (Q) are different abilities
- Feint (W) grants a shield for a short duration
- Shadow Dash (E) only hits champions
Jade_Shen.blurb:
- Ki Strike (Passive) and Vorpal Blade (Q) are different abilities
- Feint (W) grants a shield for a short duration
- Shadow Dash (E) only hits champions

spells.name: Vorpal Blade
spells.description: Damages target unit and life taps him, healing allies that attack the target.
spells.tooltip: Shen throws a vorpal blade, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totalmagicdamage_jade }} magic damage</magicDamage> to target unit, marking them for {{ markduration_jade }} seconds. Allied spells and attacks against this target heal them for <healing>{{ totalhealovertimeamount_jade }}</healing> over {{ healduration_jade }} seconds. Killing an enemy with this Ability restores <healing>{{ totalheal_jade }} Health</healing> instantly instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Feint
spells.description: Shen shields himself, absorbing incoming damage for a few seconds.
spells.tooltip: Shen grants himself <shield>{{ totalshieldamount }} Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. While this Ability holds, his attacks reduce <keywordMajor>Ki Strike's</keywordMajor> Cooldown by an additional {{ passivecooldownreduction }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.description: Shen dashes rapidly toward a target location, taunting enemy champions he encounters and dealing minor damage.
spells.tooltip: Shen dashes, <status>Taunting</status> for {{ tauntduration }} second(s) and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldashdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> on collision with enemy champions. <status>Taunted</status> champions are forced to attack Shen and deal {{ physdamagereductionratio*100 }}% reduced physical damage. Restores <keywordMajor>{{ energyrestore }} Energy</keywordMajor> per champion affected.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Stand United
spells.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
spells.tooltip: Shen grants an allied champion <shield>{{ totalshield }} Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. After channeling for {{ channelduration }} seconds, Shen Teleports to his ally's location.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Ki Strike
passive.description: Periodically, Shen's next attack deals bonus damage. Each time Shen attacks a minion, monster, or champion, Ki Strike's cooldown is reduced.

Jade_Shyvana.name: Shyvana
Jade_Shyvana.lore:
- Dragon's Descent (R) has a different passive and properties
