spells.name: Expunge
spells.description: All nearby enemies secrete Twitch's toxic venoms from their bodies, dealing damage for each stack.
spells.tooltip: Twitch deals <physicalDamage>{{ basedamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> plus <physicalDamage>{{ totalstackdamage }}</physicalDamage> per stack of <keywordMajor>Deadly Venom</keywordMajor> to all marked nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spray and Pray
spells.description: Twitch closes his eyes and fires his crossbow, rapidly spraying powerful piercing bolts ahead of him.
spells.tooltip: For {{ duration }} seconds Twitch gains {{ bonusrange }} Attack Range, <physicalDamage>{{ bonusad }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> and his basic attacks become piercing bolts that deal {{ falloffdamage*100 }}% less damage to subsequent targets down to a minimum of {{ minimumfalloffdamage*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target, dealing magic damage each second.

Jade_Vayne.name: Vayne
Jade_Vayne.title: The Night Hunter
Jade_Vayne.lore: - Final Hour (R) can not be extended
Jade_Vayne.blurb: - Final Hour (R) can not be extended

spells.name: Tumble
spells.description: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot.  Her next attack deals bonus damage.
spells.tooltip: Rolls a short distance. The next basic attack within {{ buffduration }} seconds deals <physicalDamage>{{ scalingdamagetotal }} bonus physical damage</physicalDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Silver Bolts
spells.description: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things.  The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's maximum Health as bonus true damage.
spells.tooltip: Every third consecutive attack or ability against an enemy deals an additional {{ basedamage }} plus {{ maxhealthratio*100 }}% of the enemy's maximum Health <trueDamage>true damage</trueDamage>. (Max: {{ monsterdamagecap }} damage vs. Monsters){{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Condemn
spells.description: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, dealing damage and knocking them back.  If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.
spells.tooltip: Fires a bolt that deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and knocks the enemy back. Enemies that collide with terrain take <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamagewithspell }} additional physical damage</physicalDamage> and are <status>Stunned</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Final Hour
spells.description: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, invisibility during Tumble, and greatly increased bonus Movement Speed from Night Hunter.
spells.tooltip: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains <physicalDamage>{{ admod }} Bonus Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for {{ duration }} seconds. While active, Tumble grants <keywordStealth>Invisibility</keywordStealth> for {{ invisibilityduration }} seconds, and <spellName>Night Hunter's</spellName> bonus <speed>Movement Speed</speed> is increased to {{ ultimatemovementspeed }}.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Night Hunter
passive.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers. She gains bonus Movement Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

Jade_Veigar.name: Veigar
Jade_Veigar.title: The Tiny Maser of Evil
Jade_Veigar.lore:
- Baleful Strike (Q) is point and click
- Event Horizon (E) is instant
- Equilibrium (P) gains increased mana regeneration based on missing mana
Jade_Veigar.blurb:
- Baleful Strike (Q) is point and click
- Event Horizon (E) is instant
- Equilibrium (P) gains increased mana regeneration based on missing mana

spells.name: Baleful Strike
spells.description: Unleashes dark energy at target enemy, dealing magic damage. If a unit is killed, Veigar gains some Ability Power permanently.
spells.tooltip:
Active: Veigar unleashes dark energy at target enemy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. If the target is killed, Veigar gains {{ apperstack }} Ability Power. This bonus is doubled against Champions, large minions and large monsters.

Passive: Veigar gains {{ apperkill }} Ability Power when he kills a champion from any source of damage.

Bonus Ability Power: +{{ f1 }}{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dark Matter
spells.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands.
spells.tooltip: After {{ impactdelay }} seconds, dark matter falls from the sky to the target location, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.description: Veigar twists the edges of space around the target location for 3 seconds, stunning enemies who pass through the perimeter for a short duration.
spells.tooltip: Veigar twists the edges of space around the target location for {{ cageduration }} seconds, <status>Stunning</status> enemies who pass through the perimeter for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Primordial Burst
spells.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large base amount of magic damage plus 80% of his target's AP.
spells.tooltip: Veigar blasts an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>{{ mindamage }} plus {{ enemyapratio*100 }}% of his target's Ability Power in magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Equilibrium
passive.description: Veigar's mana regeneration increases based on his missing mana.

Jade_Warwick.name: Warwick
Jade_Warwick.title: The Blood Hunter
Jade_Warwick.lore:
- The Abilities are completely different
- Infinite Duress (R) is a point and click suppress
Jade_Warwick.blurb:
- The Abilities are completely different
- Infinite Duress (R) is a point and click suppress

spells.name: Hungering Strike
spells.description: Takes a bite out of an enemy unit and heals Warwick.
spells.tooltip: Strikes an enemy for the greater value between <magicDamage>{{ totalflatdamage }}</magicDamage> and <magicDamage>{{ maxhealthdamage*100 }}% + {{ apdamage }}</magicDamage> of the target's maximum Health as <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> (can only do flat damage to monsters), and <healing>heals</healing> Warwick for {{ healingratio*100 }}% of the damage dealt.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hunter's Call
spells.description: Warwick lets out a howl, increasing all friendly champions' Attack Speed for a short time.
spells.tooltip: Warwick lets out a howl that inspires all allied champions, increasing Warwick's <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by {{ attackspeedmod*100 }}%</attackSpeed> and all friendly champions' <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by {{ allyattackspeedmod*100 }}%</attackSpeed> for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blood Scent
spells.description: Warwick passively senses weakened enemy champions around him.  The scent of blood sends him into a fury, causing him to move at incredible speeds.
spells.tooltip: <spellPassive>Passive: </spellPassive>Warwick senses enemy champions under 50% Health within {{ range }} distance of him; while he detects a low-health enemy, he gains <speed>{{ msbonus*100 }}% Movement Speed</speed>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Infinite Duress
spells.description: Warwick lunges at an enemy champion, suppressing his target and dealing magic damage for a few seconds.
spells.tooltip:
Warwick lunges in front of an enemy champion and Suppresses them for {{ rduration }} seconds. During this time, Warwick attacks his victim {{ numberofhits }} times, dealing a total of {{ totaldamage }} magic damage (triggers on-hit effects {{ numberofhits }} times).

Warwick gains {{ bonuslifesteal*100 }}% Life Steal for the duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Eternal Thirst
passive.description: Each of Warwick's attacks will heal him. Each successive attack against the same target will steal more and more Health.

Jade_Wukong.name: Wukong
Jade_Wukong.title: The Monkey King
Jade_Wukong.lore:
- Decoy (W) does not mirror other abilities used and does not auto attack
- Cyclone (R) only has 1 activation
Jade_Wukong.blurb:
- Decoy (W) does not mirror other abilities used and does not auto attack
- Cyclone (R) only has 1 activation

spells.name: Crushing Blow
spells.description: Wukong's next attack gains extra range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the enemy's Armor.
spells.tooltip: Wukong's next Attack has {{ bonusattackrange }} bonus Attack Range, deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and reduces the enemy's <scaleArmor>Armor by {{ armorshredpercent*-100 }}%</scaleArmor> for {{ shredduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Decoy
spells.description: Wukong becomes invisible and spawns an uncontrollable decoy that will damage nearby enemies after a short delay.
spells.tooltip: Wukong becomes <keywordStealth>Invisible</keywordStealth> for {{ stealthduration }} seconds. An uncontrollable decoy is left behind that will deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies near it after {{ cloneduration }} seconds.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Nimbus Strike
spells.description: Wukong dashes toward a target enemy and sends out images to attack up to 2 additional enemies near his target, dealing physical damage to each enemy struck.
spells.tooltip: Wukong dashes toward a target enemy and sends out images to attack up to 2 additional enemies near his target, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to each enemy struck. Upon hitting his target, Wukong gains <attackSpeed>{{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Cyclone
spells.description: Wukong's staff grows outward and he spins it around, dealing damage and knocking up enemies. Wukong gains movement speed over the duration of the spell.
spells.tooltip: Wukong's staff grows outward and he spins it around, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ damagepersecondtotal }} physical damage</physicalDamage> per second and <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies he encounters. Wukong gains <speed>Move Speed</speed> over the duration of the spell. Lasts {{ spinduration }} seconds. <recast>Recast:</recast> Cancels the ultimate early.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.description: Increases Wukong's armor and magic resistance for each nearby enemy champion.

Jade_XinZhao.name: Xin Zhao
Jade_XinZhao.lore:
- Challenge (Passive) is moved from R to occupy the Passive slot
- Battle Cry (W) is a different ability, read the description
- Audacious Charge (E) no longer increases attack speed or extends range of ability
- Crescent Sweep (R) grants Armor and MR instead of damage immunity
Jade_XinZhao.blurb:
- Challenge (Passive) is moved from R to occupy the Passive slot
- Battle Cry (W) is a different ability, read the description
- Audacious Charge (E) no longer increases attack speed or extends range of ability
- Crescent Sweep (R) grants Armor...

spells.name: Three Talon Strike
spells.description: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage that reduce his other ability cooldowns, with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.
spells.tooltip: Xin Zhao's next 3 basic Attacks deal <physicalDamage>{{ totalbonusdamageperhit }} bonus physical damage</physicalDamage> and reduce his other abilities' cooldowns by 1 second. The final strike also <status>Knocks Up</status> for {{ knockupduration }} seconds.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Battle Cry
spells.description: Xin Zhao passively heals every 3 attacks and can activate this ability to attack faster.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Xin Zhao heals himself for {{ totalhealamount }} every third basic attack.

Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a Battle Cry, increasing his Attack Speed by {{ attackspeedbonus*100 }}% for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Audacious Charge
spells.description: Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing damage and slowing all enemies in the area.
spells.tooltip: Xin Zhao charges and <keywordMajor>Challenges</keywordMajor> an enemy. The charge deals <magicDamage>{{ totalmagicdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to all nearby enemies and <status>Slows</status> them by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. </mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Crescent Sweep
spells.description: Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back. Xin Zhao gains bonus Armor and Magic Resist based on number of champions hit.
spells.tooltip: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} plus {{ percentcurrenthealthdamage*100 }}% current Health physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Knocks Back</status> all <keywordMajor>non-Challenged</keywordMajor> enemies. Xin Zhao gains {{ scalingresist }} <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for {{ resistduration }} seconds for each champion hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Challenge
passive.description: Xin Zhao challenges his target with his basic attacks and Audacious Charge, reducing its armor by 15% for 3 seconds.

Jade_Zilean.name: Zilean
Jade_Zilean.title: The Chronokeeper
Jade_Zilean.lore:
- Time Bomb (Q) is point and click
- Heightened Learning (P) grants experience to his entire team
Jade_Zilean.blurb:
- Time Bomb (Q) is point and click
- Heightened Learning (P) grants experience to his entire team

spells.name: Time Bomb
spells.description: Zilean places a time bomb on his target, which damages nearby enemies once it expires.
spells.tooltip:
Zilean places a time-delayed bomb on a target. After {{ countdowntimer }} seconds this bomb will detonate, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to all surrounding enemies.

Placing a second Time Bomb on a target will immediately detonate the first one.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rewind
spells.description: Zilean reduces all of his other cooldowns.
spells.tooltip: Zilean reduces all of his other Ability cooldowns by {{ cooldownrefund }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Time Warp
spells.description: Zilean increases an allied Champion's movement speed or slows an enemy champion.
spells.tooltip: Zilean increases an allied Champion's <speed>Movement Speed</speed> or <status>Slows</status> an enemy Champion by {{ movespeedmod*100 }}% for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Chronoshift
spells.description: Zilean marks himself or an allied champion with a protective time rune. If they would take lethal damage, they are instead transported back in time and healed.
spells.tooltip: Zilean marks himself or an allied champion with a protective time rune for {{ rduration }} seconds. If they would take lethal damage, they are instead transported back in time, regaining <healing>{{ rtotalheal }} Health</healing>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Heightened Learning
passive.description: Zilean and his allies gain additional experience.
